summary: Iran's IRGC launched missile attacks on six vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, including three oil tankers and three U.S. ships, marking a major escalation. The U.S. responded by deploying KC-46A tankers from Fairchild AFB and CENTCOM confirmed the attack on a U.S. aircraft carrier and guided-missile destroyer. Meanwhile, the IDF conducted operations in Gaza and Lebanon, and Israeli rockets were fired toward the Golan Heights.
key_points: Iran's IRGC attacked six ships in the Strait of Hormuz, including three oil tankers traveling illegally and three American vessels, via missile strikes (Source: @kianmeli1/91553).
The U.S. Air Force deployed three KC-46A tankers (RCH096, RCH097, RCH098) from Fairchild AFB with sequential callsigns, indicating outbound movement (Source: @shin_persian/9473).
CENTCOM confirmed Iran attacked a U.S. aircraft carrier and guided-missile destroyer, stating no American personnel were harmed (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6846).
Admiral Brad Cooper warned that an IRGC attack on two U.S. ships would trigger strikes on three Iranian ships, and Iran's exposed oil fleet could be destroyed (Source: @shin_persian/9465).
Explosions were heard in Qeshm and Jask, with IRIB attributing the sounds to action against vessels accused of violations in the Strait of Hormuz, not local explosions (Source: @shin_persian/9470).
The IDF fired at a target in the Gaza Strip that was later identified as IDF fire from operations in the area; no injuries were reported (Source: @yediotnews25/134674).

The IDF is reducing forces in southern Lebanon after destroying the Ali Tahrir ridge tunnel network, with discussions about establishing a new security zone closer to the border (Source: @yediotnews25/134672).
The Israeli army fired rockets toward the Golan Heights border after detecting suspected individuals attempting to plant an explosive device in the area (Source: @naya_foriraq/89437).

sections.executive_summary: Iran's IRGC launched missile attacks on six vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, including three oil tankers and three U.S. ships, marking a major escalation. The U.S. responded by deploying KC-46A tankers from Fairchild AFB and CENTCOM confirmed the attack on a U.S. aircraft carrier and guided-missile destroyer. Meanwhile, the IDF conducted operations in Gaza and Lebanon, and Israeli rockets were fired toward the Golan Heights.
iran: The IRGC launched missile attacks on six vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, targeting three oil tankers traveling illegally and three American ships, according to multiple sources (Source: @kianmeli1/91553).

Explosions were heard in Qeshm and Jask, with local IRIB reporter attributing the sounds to action against vessels accused of violations in the Strait of Hormuz, not explosions within the areas themselves (Source: @shin_persian/9470).
A separate report stated the explosions in Qeshm resulted from rocket launches toward the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @naya_foriraq/89434).

Admiral Brad Cooper of CENTCOM warned that an IRGC attack on two U.S. ships would draw strikes on three Iranian ships, and Iran's exposed oil fleet could also be destroyed (Source: @shin_persian/9465).
The U.S. Air Force deployed three KC-46A tankers from Fairchild AFB with sequential callsigns RCH096, RCH097, and RCH098, indicating outbound movement (Source: @shin_persian/9473).

The Iranian rial plummeted to 228,000 tomans per U.S. dollar, with the Central Bank Governor claiming sufficient reserves and readiness to inject up to two billion dollars, though currency continues to fall (Source: @VahidOnline/78240).
israel: The IDF fired at a target in the Gaza Strip that was later identified as IDF fire from operations conducted within the area; no injuries were reported and the incident is under review (Source: @yediotnews25/134674).

The IDF is reducing forces in southern Lebanon after destroying the Ali Tahrir ridge tunnel network, with security discussions about establishing a new security zone closer to the Israeli border (Source: @yediotnews25/134672).
The Israeli army fired rockets toward the Golan Heights border after detecting a group of suspected individuals attempting to plant an explosive device in the area (Source: @naya_foriraq/89437).
Initial reports emerged of a shooting incident in the Netanya settlement (Source: @naya_foriraq/89426).
A new settlement project surrounding Jerusalem with 3,600 units was reported, including 370 dunams under control to strangle and isolate the city (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/389077).

An interceptor was launched toward a false target in southern Gaza that was later identified as IDF fire from operations in the area; no injuries were reported and no sirens were sounded (Source: @shin_persian/9472).
gaza_west_bank: The IDF fired at a target in the Gaza Strip that was later identified as IDF fire from operations conducted within the southern Gaza Strip area; no injuries were reported and the incident is under review (Source: @yediotnews25/134674).

An interceptor was launched toward a false target in the southern Gaza Strip that was identified as IDF fire from operations in the area; no injuries were reported and no sirens were sounded per protocol (Source: @shin_persian/9472).

The U.S. Ambassador to Israel, Mike Hakobi, visited the Palestinian village of Tormus in the Ramallah area of the West Bank, meeting with Palestinian families affected by Jewish extremist violence (Source: @lelotsenzura/94306).
Approximately 80% of Tormus residents hold U.S. citizenship, and the Ambassador stated that attacks by Jewish extremists constitute terrorism with serious consequences (Source: @lelotsenzura/94306).
lebanon: The IDF is reducing forces in southern Lebanon after destroying the Ali Tahrir ridge tunnel network, according to security sources (Source: @yediotnews25/134672).

Security system discussions have been held recently about establishing a new security zone closer to the Israeli border, from which the IDF will protect residents of the line of confrontation (Source: @yediotnews25/134672).
syria_iraq: The Israeli army fired rockets toward the Golan Heights border after detecting a group of suspected individuals attempting to plant an explosive device in the area (Source: @naya_foriraq/89437).

Armed groups closed the NRT channel, owned by the Barzani family's opposition, in Dohuk governorate, northern Iraq, due to its publication of a report on the poor economic situation in Dohuk (Source: @naya_foriraq/89429).
Violent clashes occurred between the Yemeni Armed Forces and Saudi mercenaries in western Taaz (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/389121).

sections.threat_assessment: The Strait of Hormuz is the primary threat vector, with Iran's IRGC having launched missile attacks on six vessels including three U.S. ships. The U.S. has deployed KC-46A tankers and CENTCOM has confirmed the attack on an aircraft carrier and destroyer, with Admiral Cooper warning of strikes on Iranian ships. The situation is highly volatile with potential for further escalation. In parallel, the IDF is conducting operations across multiple fronts including Gaza, Lebanon, and the Golan Heights, with incidents of friendly fire and false target interceptions indicating operational complexity.
sections.regional_response: The U.S. has responded with tanker deployments and public warnings of retaliation through CENTCOM. Iran continues to assert its actions targeted vessels accused of violations in the Strait of Hormuz. Israel is reducing forces in Lebanon while maintaining operations in Gaza and defending the Golan Heights. The Palestinian Authority has not issued a formal response, but the U.S. Ambassador's visit to the West Bank signals continued diplomatic engagement. Qatar's LNG terminal showing unusual thermal activity may indicate an unrelated industrial event or potential targeting.
sections.intelligence_notes: The IRGC's attack on six vessels in the Strait of Hormuz represents a significant escalation, with the U.S. confirming damage to an aircraft carrier and destroyer. The deployment of three KC-46A tankers from Fairchild AFB suggests U.S. preparation for extended operations. Iran's economic situation is deteriorating with the rial at 228,000 tomans per dollar, potentially affecting regime stability. The IDF's operations in Lebanon, Gaza, and the Golan Heights indicate a multi-front conflict posture. Satellite imagery of Qatar's Ras Laffan LNG terminal showing 120 MW thermal energy requires further analysis to determine if it is industrial or weapon-related.
